findings.message: U101 (LM74700-Q1): V(CATHODE-ANODE) 66 vs rating 75 (88%) (PVA_P to PVA_IN) — above 80% derating
findings.waived_by: designer: Interval artefact: 66 V pairs +33 V on PVx_P with the string reversed at -33 V. PVx_P is fed only by its string (no back-feed path from VINT through the buck-boost body diodes or from AUX_IN through D601/D602), so with the string reversed PVx_P decays to 0 V and V(CATHODE-ANODE) <= 33 V (44 % of 75 V).

findings.message: U401 (AMC3330QDWERQ1) package creepage 8 mm < required 10 mm
findings.waived_by: designer: The 10 mm barrier creepage is the PCB (material group IIIa) value. AMC3330/AMC3302 packages are CTI >= 600 V (group I) [P], for which IEC 60664-1 F.4 needs 2.5 mm basic / 5.0 mm reinforced at 500 V [S]; the packages give >= 8 mm, and a >= 2 mm routed slot under each body gives the PCB path >= 10 mm (framework compares one number; see report note).

findings.message: external hv net HV_N reaches the board without a fuse/PTC on it
findings.waived_by: designer: These nets are fused where the energy is: F901/F902 sit first from the pack at the battery end and D901 blocks pack current toward the cable; from our side HV_P is current-limited (0.30 A cap, 0.40 A latch, < 0.85 A physical). PACK_SNS has 3 MOhm in series at the battery end (<= 133 uA).

findings.message: external power net PVA_IN reaches the board without a fuse/PTC on it
findings.waived_by: designer: A PV string is a current source (Isc 6.3 A at 1 sun, 7.3 A worst case) below every rating in its path (J101 12 A, 2.5 mm2 cable, Q101 100 A); one string per input, no parallel strings to back-feed it, so no string fuse is needed [S: IEC 62548 requires string fuses only for >= 3 parallel strings].
